case_title.quote: BARKU BHAVRAO BHASKAR v. STATE OF MAHARASHTRA
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

number_of_accused.quote: The sole accused is the appellant before us.
number_of_accused.reason: Judgment states there is a sole accused.

accused_gender.quote: He was convicted by the trial Court
accused_gender.reason: Accused referred to as male throughout.

accused_age.reason: Judgment never states the accused's age.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.quote: The appellant also worked under PW-1 on certain occasions
accused_occupation.reason: Occupation is not stated; only occasional work under PW-1 is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: the deceased was a female child aged about 6 years
victim_gender.reason: Victim is stated to be female.

victim_age.reason: Victim age given as about 6 years.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: The accused was also related to the family of PW-1.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused is described as a relative; the judgment also says being a relative.

offence_category.quote: the appellant was responsible for the killing of the deceased Rakhi
offence_category.reason: Core offence is murder under s.302, with kidnapping and disappearance charges also.

statutory_provisions.quote: for the offences punishable under Sections 364, 302 and 201 of IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: s.302 is right, but s.34 and Arms Act s.27 are not in the judgment, and ss.364 and 201 are omitted.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned in the judgment.

evidence_type.correct_value: Circumstantial, medical, recovery, extra-judicial confession, last-seen witness testimony, motive evidence
evidence_type.quote: The case on hand was based on the circumstantial evidence
evidence_type.reason: No dying declaration is mentioned; extra-judicial confession and witness testimony are omitted.

confession.quote: the appellant made an extra-judicial confession by stating that if he was not beaten
confession.reason: Extra-judicial confession is recorded and treated as a proved circumstance.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment does not identify aggravating circumstances; the listed items are evidence, not labelled aggravating factors.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted by the trial Court in Sessions Case No.49 of 2001, for the offences punishable under Sections 364, 302 and 201 of IPC
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court conviction under ss.364, 302 and 201.

high_court_outcome.quote: On appeal, the High Court having confirmed the conviction and sentence imposed
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court confirmed conviction and sentence.

final_outcome.quote: The appeal fails, the same is dismissed.
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, leaving conviction intact.

offence_finally_established.quote: he was imposed with sentence of life for the offence proved under Section 302 IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Section 302 murder conviction is identified as the proved offence.

imprisonment_type.quote: He was imposed with sentence of life
imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment is stated for s.302.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life term has no fixed years, so null is appropriate.

fine_rs.quote: The trial Court also imposed fine with a default sentence.
fine_rs.reason: Fine imposed but amount not stated, so null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: The accused was last seen with a 6-year-old female child who was later found dead; the body was recovered at the accused's instance; the blood-stained shirt was recovered at his instance; bloodstains matched the victim's blood group; the accused made an extra-judicial confession; there was a wage-related motive.
neutral_facts.quote: no injuries on the body of the appellant ... ruled out ... blood stains from the body of the appellant to get transmitted to his shirt
neutral_facts.reason: Largely accurate but repeats the body-recovery sentence and says self-inflicted bloodstains were ruled out, which the judgment does not say.

offence_severity.quote: five years' rigorous imprisonment for the offence under Section 354 IPC apart from three years rigorous imprisonment for the offence under Section 201 IPC
offence_severity.reason: Sentences match the judgment, including its reference to s.354.

attempt_completion.quote: the dead body of the deceased Rakhi was recovered
attempt_completion.reason: Murder was completed, as the death and body recovery are established.

physical_harm.quote: cardio-respiratory arrest on account of the head injuries
physical_harm.reason: Head and ear injuries and cardio-respiratory arrest are supported.

number_of_offences.quote: for the offences punishable under Sections 364, 302 and 201 of IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Three offences are charged and convicted, and the High Court confirmed them.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is mentioned, so 'Not applicable' is equivalent.

premeditation_planning.reason: Judgment never finds premeditation or planning; it only describes the wage-dispute motive.

motive.quote: the appellant had an axe to grind against PW-1, since PW-1 had once abused him at the village
motive.reason: Wage dispute motive and PW-1's earlier abuse are both stated.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the blood stains found in the shirt of the appellant, could have been only that of the deceased and none else
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Medical and blood-stain evidence described as accepted matches the judgment.

witness_credibility.quote: The Courts have found that there was no reason for PW-3 to utter any falsehood
witness_credibility.reason: Credibility findings for PW-3 and PW-7 and the child witness conduct are supported.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused led police to the victim's body and his blood-stained shirt, and made an extra-judicial confession
post_offence_conduct.quote: the appellant having led the prosecution to discover his blood stained clothes and the body of the deceased
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment records conduct after the offence (leading to discovery), so 'Not stated' is wrong.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence date 03.12.2000; High Court judgment 10.02.2006; Supreme Court judgment 25.07.2013; trial court judgment date not stated
trial_duration.reason: Trial court judgment date of 10.02.2006 is not in the text; that date belongs to the High Court judgment.

legal_representation.quote: P.C. Aggarwala, Revathy Raghavan for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment, though the respondent is referred to as 'Respondent', not 'State'.

investigation_status.correct_value: Complaint Ext.1 lodged at police station; trial completed; charge sheet not mentioned
investigation_status.quote: a complaint Ext.1 was lodged wherefrom
investigation_status.reason: Judgment mentions a complaint, not an FIR, and does not mention a charge sheet.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: convicted and sentenced; High Court: conviction and sentence confirmed; Supreme Court: appeal dismissed
appeal_history.quote: On appeal, the High Court having confirmed the conviction and sentence imposed
appeal_history.reason: Trial court is wrongly described as confirming the sentence; it convicted and sentenced.

prosecution_argument.quote: the motive attributed for such killing was the wage dispute
prosecution_argument.reason: Prosecution case covers last seen, confession, recovery, body discovery and motive.

defence_argument.quote: it was submitted on behalf of the appellant that the blood group of the appellant was not tested
defence_argument.reason: Defence contended doubts on homicide and untested blood group.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the conclusion that the death of the deceased was a homicidal one, has become an irreversible one
legal_principle_applied.reason: Chain of circumstances and homicidal death based on post-mortem evidence are the stated basis.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedent is cited in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Not stated; appeal dismissed in view of overwhelming evidence proving every circumstance against the appellant
sentencing_rationale.quote: Having regard to such overwhelming evidence available on record, which proved every one of the circumstances
sentencing_rationale.reason: Judgment gives reasons for dismissing the appeal but no separate sentencing rationale.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are expressly identified by the court.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Fine imposed with default sentence (amount not stated)
other_sentence_order.quote: The trial Court also imposed fine with a default sentence.
other_sentence_order.reason: A fine with default sentence was ordered, so 'None' is incorrect.
